documents.title: Rolling infrastructure rebuild — the old infrastructure builds the new
documents.summary: Rebuild service by service using the running homelab to provision its replacement; no big-bang rebuild, no full hardware duplication.

documents.title: pve-management is a standalone bootstrap, orchestration and recovery host
documents.summary: The fresh Proxmox host pve-management stays outside the compute cluster and runs only management VMs (IaC toolchain, runner, later Windmill/Phase).
headings: ADR-002: pve-management as a standalone host

documents.title: OpenTofu for new infrastructure roots; legacy Terraform roots migrate individually
documents.summary: New roots use OpenTofu with bpg/proxmox; existing Terraform roots keep Terraform until each is migrated with a verified no-change plan.

documents.title: Phase for runtime secrets, SOPS + age for bootstrap and recovery secrets
documents.summary: Phase is the confirmed Infisical replacement (deployment gated on validating its self-hosted free edition); SOPS+age protects bootstrap material so recovery never needs Phase, Forgejo or Windmill.
headings: ADR-004: Secrets — Phase at runtime, SOPS + age for bootstrap

documents.title: Windmill is the operations UI over a versioned service catalog
documents.summary: Each service declares a service.yaml catalog entry whose input schema drives a Windmill form; Windmill triggers versioned workflows and never replaces OpenTofu, Ansible or Forgejo.
headings: ADR-005: Windmill over a versioned service catalog

documents.title: Docker Compose first; k3s and Argo CD later, only where they add value
documents.summary: Applications run as Compose projects on VMs; k3s with Argo CD is a future option. Supersedes the legacy K3s/Flux-first direction.

documents.title: Archive the legacy Codex workflow; keep live legacy IaC roots in place until migrated
documents.summary: Old AGENTS.md, roadmap, tasks and docs moved verbatim to docs/archive/codex-2026; legacy Terraform/Ansible code that still manages live resources stays at its path.
headings: ADR-007: Archive the legacy workflow, keep live roots

documents.title: Bootstrap runs from the operator workstation; CT301 stays validation-only
documents.summary: The first OpenTofu applies on pve-management run from the workstation through approval-gated Make targets; CT301 never holds Proxmox credentials nor applies; a trusted runner comes later.

documents.title: The management VM is the operator's GNOME admin workstation
documents.summary: mgmt-control-01 is a GNOME admin workstation (Ubuntu 26.04, 8 vCPU host type, 10 GiB, 120 GiB) with RDP remote login, the IaC toolchain, Claude Code and Codex.
headings: ADR-009: Management VM as a GNOME admin workstation

documents.title: The new Proxmox cluster is founded on pve-management and grows with reclaimed hosts
documents.summary: pve-management founds the new Proxmox cluster; the emptied pve-core joins first, every reclaimed host follows by the same repeatable process. Supersedes ADR-002.
headings: ADR-010: New Proxmox cluster founded on pve-management

documents.title: k3s is the application platform from the start, reconciled by Argo CD and administered with Headlamp
documents.summary: New applications run on k3s (OpenTofu VMs, Ansible bootstrap, embedded etcd); Argo CD reconciles them from Forgejo; Headlamp is the Kubernetes UI; Windmill automates workflows. Supersedes ADR-006.
headings: ADR-011: k3s first, Argo CD for GitOps, Headlamp for administration

documents.title: Kubernetes persistent data lives on NVMe-backed storage outside k3s; TrueNAS is the backup destination; Ceph later
documents.summary: PVCs come through CSI from NVMe-backed storage outside k3s on the physical hosts; TrueNAS only receives backups; Ceph (RBD, CephFS) is the future distributed layer.
headings: ADR-012: External NVMe-backed Kubernetes storage, TrueNAS for backups, Ceph later

documents.title: A central PostgreSQL platform with Patroni replication serves the applications
documents.summary: Applications get their own database, role and credentials on a shared PostgreSQL platform managed by Patroni (Zalando Postgres Operator pending validation), on external NVMe-backed PVCs.

documents.title: A dedicated Forgejo runner VM executes approved infrastructure workflows
documents.summary: A runner VM created with OpenTofu and configured with Ansible runs approved OpenTofu, Ansible, k3s and Helm jobs with scoped credentials; CT301 stays validation-only. Amends ADR-008.

documents.title: PostgreSQL runs on three Patroni VMs outside k3s
documents.summary: Operator decision 2026-11-17: the shared PostgreSQL platform is three Patroni VMs outside k3s with etcd and a virtual IP, not an operator inside k3s.
headings: ADR-015: PostgreSQL runs on three Patroni VMs outside k3s

documents.title: NetBox is the inventory and IPAM source of truth, populated from Git and read-only discovery
documents.summary: NetBox on k3s holds the intended inventory and address plan; Git owns what OpenTofu defines, Proxmox is only observed, NetBox is never a bootstrap dependency.
headings: ADR-016: NetBox is the inventory and IPAM source of truth, populated from Git and read-only discovery

documents.title: Authentik is the single sign-on of the platform, declared in Git, never a bootstrap dependency
documents.summary: Authentik on k3s signs people in to the web interfaces; applications and groups are blueprints in Git, people live in Authentik, and each service keeps a local administrator.
headings: ADR-017: Authentik is the single sign-on of the platform, declared in Git, never a bootstrap dependency

documents.title: NetBox holds the physical inventory: Git says what a device is, machines report their hardware, people place it
documents.summary: Device identity comes from inventory.yaml, hardware and cabling from what hosts and the switch report, placement stays with people in NetBox; diagram plugins are installed on a volume.
headings: NetBox holds the physical inventory: Git says what a device is, machines report their hardware, people place it
